title: Cheap But Still a Waste of Money
text: Cheap But Still a Waste of Money. These sheets are incredibly shoddy. Slick & thin, they don't feel like sheets at all. I've gotten some great deals on sheets here on Amazon, but these crappy things aren't one of them.
